curiosity_trigger: sorting loose wall stones and noticing how uneven pieces can still form a stable, carefully aligned structure
reaction: pauses with the stone in hand, studies the straight garden wall, then looks thoughtful
book_retrieval: sets the stone down, brushes dust from his hands, crosses to the nearby shelf, and pulls down the worn volume marked Egypt
world_style_hint: sun-bleached archaeological sketchbook aesthetic with warm papyrus grain, charcoal-and-ochre linework, measured architectural diagrams, and restrained desert blue accents
reason: Working with ordinary garden-wall stones naturally prompts questions about planning, moving, and aligning much larger stone structures without forcing a pyramid-shaped object into the home world.
